clear_points_possible.description: turn a directly graded component back into a bucket; not once a grade has been entered on it (optional; omit or null)

existing_grades.description: rescale or keep_scores: what becomes of grades already entered on a directly graded component when its points_possible changes, required once any has been; as for assignment.update. Needs grade_submit and grade_post as well (optional; omit or null)

points_possible.description: a decimal number; a string is accepted where exactness matters, with at most 40 digits either side of the point and an exponent of at most two digits (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5") (optional; omit or null)

weight.description: a decimal number; a string is accepted where exactness matters, with at most 40 digits either side of the point and an exponent of at most two digits (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5") (optional; omit or null)
